data.one_liner: A Dart backend framework inspired by Spring Boot, using annotations for controllers, DI, and OpenAPI docs.
data.what_it_does: Vaden provides a fast, expressive server experience with annotation-based controllers, dependency injection, middlewares, guards, DTOs, and automatic OpenAPI documentation. It is built on top of Shelf and aims to simplify backend development in Dart.
use_when: You need a full-featured backend framework with DI and OpenAPI support
You prefer annotation-based configuration over manual routing
You want to quickly scaffold a new Dart server project
avoid_when: You only need a lightweight HTTP server without DI
You are building a client-side application
You prefer a purely functional or reactive style
strengths: Annotation-based DI and routing reduce boilerplate
Built-in OpenAPI generation and Swagger UI
Fast startup and efficient class scanning
weaknesses: Depends on Shelf, so inherits its limitations
No official support for mobile platforms
data.setup_notes: Create a new project via https://start.vaden.dev or manually add dependencies, then run the generated main.dart. No build_runner needed.
